MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle feels useful because it connects my earlier interest in home security alarms with the Alexa devices I already use.",
    "Voice-controlled lighting feels like a natural next step because it gives my existing Alexa setup a new use, and the included bulb makes that possibility concrete."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Dot and Fire TV Stick repeat functions covered by my recent fourth-generation Dot, Echo Show, and Fire TV Stick 4K Max purchases.",
    "My external hard drive and card-reader purchases do not mean I need internal SSDs or an enclosure; I have no upgrade planned or spare M.2 drive to use.",
    "The display cable and earbuds depend on needs or devices I have not established, such as a DisplayPort connection or a Lightning-equipped iPhone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Alexa devices seems to have been treated as a reason to recommend more speakers and streaming devices, even when they duplicate what I recently bought.",
    "My computer-accessory purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in specialized storage and connection hardware without a matching task."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already addressed; an older replacement has little appeal without a new reason to buy it.",
    "Compatibility and a concrete purpose matter to me: a useful peripheral must work with equipment I actually have and solve a current problem.",
    "Adding home monitoring or lighting is appealing because it expands what my existing devices can do."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics, but miss the difference between extending my setup and duplicating it or assuming an unconfirmed hardware need."
}
